name: zsnd_cd_track_list_static_lifecycle
description: zSndCdTrackList CRT static lifecycle constructs the global CD track-list sentinel, registers the atexit destructor, and deletes the sentinel list at process exit.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

The constructor guard byte is source-modeled as a constructed-state byte. Binary Ninja shows the retail compiler helper storing a scratch-stack byte before sentinel allocation, so the reconstructed marker remains limited until a byte-safe static-init pass resolves that compiler artifact.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a2020 validates storing the constructor guard byte, allocating a 12-byte zSndCdTrackNode sentinel with operator new, setting next and prev to the sentinel, publishing g_zSndCd_TrackListHead, and clearing g_zSndCd_TrackCount.

Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a2060 validates walking g_zSndCd_TrackListHead, unlinking and deleting every node, decrementing g_zSndCd_TrackCount per node, deleting the sentinel, clearing g_zSndCd_TrackListHead, and clearing g_zSndCd_TrackCount. It does not free zSndCdTrackEntry payloads.
Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a2050 validates atexit(zSndCdTrackList::StaticDestructor), and 0x4a2010 validates StaticConstructor followed by tail dispatch to RegisterAtExitDestructor.
Native smokes verify direct sentinel construction, direct static destruction over two linked nodes, and the StaticInit atexit path in an isolated child process.
